name: web-fintech-project-intro-with-tilted-card-and-side-nav
title: Card management showcase with a floating tilted card, rail icons and laurel rating
whatItIs: A white page with a light sans and bold italic serif headline 'Payno. Simplifies and Card Management.', a large blue-to-white gradient bank card tilted and floating with a soft shadow and callout, a small left rail of icons with a Home pill, a #1 4.9 laurel and a metadata bar.
whatItMeans: Clean and premium; the floating card is the single hero object.
techniques: Float one large object with a diffuse shadow.
Mix light sans with bold italic serif.
Add a small icon rail as a hint of the UI.

vocabulary.definition: A hero object suspended with a soft shadow.
A row of project name, category and date.
A small label attached to an object.
